summary.text: Mali Anderson is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 17A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Dawn Gillman.
She advanced from the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary with 2,002 votes and no opponent.

paragraphs.text: Mali Anderson earned a high school diploma from Piedra Vista High School, degrees from Eastern New Mexico University, Roswell, and Texas A&M in 2004, and an associate degree from Ridgewater College in 2015; Ballotpedia lists her profession as community volunteer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her campaign message is "The Way Forward is Together!"

She listed universal health care, affordable housing and utilities, living wages, food security and affordable daycare among her key messages, and said she opposes rushing data centers into the district.
She also said she supports protecting the Boundary Waters Canoe Area and the headwaters of the Mississippi River and backing small family farms.
